serotype_evidence.value: Reference-grade genome from FDA ARGOS BioProject PRJNA231221

curation.notes: FDA ARGOS isolate FDAARGOS_403. Serotype O104:H4 confirmed in metadata. High-quality reference genome from FDA regulatory program.

reads.download_cmd: fasterq-dump --gzip --outdir data/ SRS2393316 && mv data/SRS2393316_1.fastq.gz data/reads_1.fq.gz && mv data/SRS2393316_2.fastq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz

assembly.download_cmd: datasets download genome accession GCF_002393365.1 --filename data/FDAARGOS_403.zip && unzip -j data/FDAARGOS_403.zip '*.fna' -d data/ && mv data/*.fna data/contigs.fa

validation_instructions.serological: Expected serotype O104:H4. Accept exact match or individual O/H antigen calls. Serotype confirmed in FDA ARGOS metadata.
validation_instructions.virulence: Expected STEC virulence genes: stx2, eae. Accept PASS if stx and eae detected. PARTIAL if stx only.

notes: FDA ARGOS O104:H4 isolate. Source: human. 2011 German outbreak strain lineage.
